messages:
lin-cs: Vela ops needs a short demo window across EU + APAC in ~90m. Asking for ephemeral QPS bump and two CIDR entries. 30m preferred.
vela-pm: Demo 08:45 UTC. CIDRs: 203.0.113.64/28 and 198.51.100.96/28. Prefer routing pinned to eu-west-1 & ap-southeast-1. We'll restart clients 3m before.
lin-cs: Request: 1) per-region QPS x3, 2) edge CIDR whitelist, 3) routing override for new conns. Auto-revoke after 30m. Capture for renewal notes (they're evaluating Dedicated).
sec-bot: Automated scan: CIDRs map to customer ASN; sec approval required for ephemeral allowlists.
navi-sre: I can do this. I'll open CR-7733 and set TTL 35m to be safe. Edge allowlist only; no control-plane changes.
meera-eng: Recommend enabling a 4m prefix cache on /v1/generate to smooth token spikes. Add to runbook?
vela-pm: Yes please, add cache. We'll restart clients as advised.
navi-sre: Runbook snippet:
```
redwoodctl edge allow-cidr --customer=vela --cidr=203.0.113.64/28 --reason="vela-demo-7733"
redwoodctl edge allow-cidr --customer=vela --cidr=198.51.100.96/28 --reason="vela-demo-7733"
redwoodctl quota set --customer=vela --region=eu-west-1 --qps-multiplier=3 --expires-in=35m
redwoodctl quota set --customer=vela --region=ap-southeast-1 --qps-multiplier=3 --expires-in=35m
redwoodctl routing override --customer=vela --preferred-regions=eu-west-1,ap-southeast-1 --tag=vela-demo-7733 --expires-in=35m
redwoodctl cache set --customer=vela --scope="/v1/generate" --type=prefix --ttl=4m --expires-in=35m
```
sec-bot: Sec review: approve edge CIDRs for ephemeral demo window. No control-plane exceptions.
deploy-bot: Applying CR-7733 -> links: https://deploys.internal/redwood/CR-7733
deploy-bot: apply: edge-allowlist/vela -> success (203.0.113.64/28), success (198.51.100.96/28) | quotas/vela -> success (eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1) | routing/override -> success | cache -> success
lin-cs: Thanks all. I'll add a short account health note and follow up on renewal next week depending on demo outcome.
vela-pm: Demo done, traffic looked good. We'll request follow-up if sustained.
navi-sre: Auto-revoke scheduled in 35m at epoch 3660014345. Will post when revoked.
